critical_code_review_comments: (tabs)/library.tsx — BookCard now calls `const styles = useStyles(makeStyles);` at its top (line 34). This resolves the ReferenceError by giving BookCard its own memoized styles closure. The double useStyles call (one in BookCard, one in Library) is fine because useStyles(factory) memoizes on colors — no perf concern for a single-book list.
Alternative would have been to move BookCard inside Library() to avoid duplicating the hook call, but the applied fix is minimal-diff, safe, and correct.
